message: The other day, I realized our smoke alarms were a bit overdue for a check-up. So, I turned it into a cozy family event! We made some hot cocoa, gathered the kids, and had a little ‘safety party’ while testing the alarms and chatting about our escape plan. It was surprisingly fun—who knew fire safety could spark such giggles? 🔥 Sometimes, it’s all in how you frame it! Have you had any unexpected family bonding moments lately?
